name: Holke-Farnam Research
author: Jesper Holke-Farnam
bio: I work in corporate finance and invest on the side. I have managed my own money for about a decade, and I am finishing an MBA with a specialization in investments.
This site is my investment journal. I publish my research and the reasoning behind each decision so I can look back, years from now, at what I actually thought at the time and grade myself honestly.
